commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+2' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Bazoumana Toure as he is replaced by Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim).
90+2' Here is a change. Fisnik Asllani is going off and Christian Ilzer gives the last tactical orders to Yannick Eduardo (Hoffenheim).
90+1' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to substitute Jakub Kaminski and he is replaced by Fynn Schenten (1. FC Koln).
90+1' Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Isak Johannesson.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' It will be a substitution. Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) is ready to enter the pitch as Andrej Kramaric walks off.
88' Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
86' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) takes the corner which is cleared.
85' Lukas Kwasniok decides to make a substitution. Said El Mala will be replaced by Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln).
85' Substitution. Ragnar Ache did his best and is replaced by Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln).
84' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

79' What a poor attempt! Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
78' Cenk Ozkacar (1. FC Koln) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
78' The attendance for today's match is 49000.
76' Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) is able to continue to play.
75' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) is booked for saying more than Robert Schroder was willing to tolerate.
75' Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
73' Substitution. Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) in, Wouter Burger out.
73' Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
72' A corner kick by Hoffenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Marvin Schwabe (1. FC Koln).
70' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Hoffenheim have a corner.
69' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to make a change. Jahmai Simpson-Pusey (1. FC Koln) replaces Sebastian Sebulonsen.
68' Hoffenheim couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Marvin Schwabe (1. FC Koln) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hoffenheim.
63' 2 - 2 Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) collects a sweet pass and lashes the ball into the middle of the net, leaving the goalkeeper rooted to the spot.
62' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
60' 1 - 2 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:2.
59' The Hoffenheim players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
59' Hoffenheim score a goal, but referee Robert Schroder has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
57' A precise short pass from Vladimir Coufal releases Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot well past the left post.
56' A pass from Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) is intercepted by Oliver Baumann and the move breaks down.
56' A long-range free kick is awarded to FC Koln.
55' It's going to be a corner kick.
54' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
53' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
52' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

51' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) and Wouter Burger have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.
47' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) is about to take a corner kick.
46' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
46' Referee Robert Schroder blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' 1 - 1 Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
44' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
42' Robert Schroder shows a yellow card to Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) for his blatant foul.
41' The foul by Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) was seen by Robert Schroder who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
37' Flag up against Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
35' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) causes Marvin Schwabe little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
33' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
32' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
30' Corner kick. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity.

29' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the top right corner, but Marvin Schwabe easily deals with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
25' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
24' There's an opportunity for Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
23' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post.
23' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) will take a corner kick.
23' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Now FC Koln have a corner.
22' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Oliver Baumann.
19' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
17' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
15' 1 - 0 GOOOOOAL! Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) finds space in the box from the lofted pass and lands the perfect scissor-kick goal. G.O.A.T? Probably not, but it’s 1:0.
15' FC Koln work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
13' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
12' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
11' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but Oliver Baumann comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Robert Schroder interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim).
5' FC Koln are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
2' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) will take the corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! FC Koln will take the kick-off.
Robert Schroder will supervise the game today.
